intro: Supplies for the Crossroads is a Horde task issued by Thork to recover essential provisions taken during Razormane quilboar raids. By reclaiming these lost supply crates from thorny encampments, adventurers help sustain the Crossroads amidst constant regional conflict.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: That attack on the caravan contained supplies we desperately needed.

You've been brave enough to take on the Razormane tribe so far, and I will ask you to do so again, but this time, I wonder if I could ask you to keep your eyes open for some of our lost supplies. You can probably find them throughout their camps, the quilboar getting fat off their dishonorable acts.
The people of the Crossroads would be in your debt.

clips.title: Progress
paras: How goes your search for the supplies, friend? I trust the quilboar fall under your strength easily.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Haha! Thank you, friend! This will help us greatly. You're a boon to the Crossroads and to the Horde. If there is anything I can do for you, please, let me know.
